title: Pyne Pod Frozen Peach Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Frozen Peach 10ml E-Liquid delivers a beautifully balanced and highly refreshing fruit experience. The profile opens with the soft, velvety sweetness of sun-ripened Peach, providing a warm and juicy inhale. To contrast the natural sweetness of the stone fruit, a crisp layer of Ice is introduced on the exhale, leaving the palate with a clean, frosty finish that makes this blend exceptionally revitalising. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the chilled fruit notes of Frozen Peach, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the bright citrus of Lemon Lime, the vibrant Fruit Punch, or the classic pairing of Strawberry Watermelon.
